answer: Stop sybils with a whisper karst pulse: agents bond one karst shaft. Each cycle the agent whispers one tone at the shaft mouth; verifiers match the returning pulse train's echo spacing to the shaft chart, voiding copies, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 shafts at 19x: one pulse train returns once per whisper, spacing set by that shaft's chambers alone, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents whisper once, keep rights.
